title: Compute brief - 27 October 2026
description: The chip vendors are now funding their customers: Nvidia puts $3 billion and AMD $1 billion into Meta's upsized $37.5 billion equity sale, and Naver's $9 billion Brookfield compute vehicle unlocks a $1 billion Nvidia investment in Naver. SoftBank plans $50 billion in Malaysia, Crusoe goes to Paraguay's Itaipú dam and CoreWeave lights Copenhagen. Tape: 70 confirms, 0 ticks, 0 NEW.
og_kicker: Nvidia and AMD are buying into the customers that buy their chips
lede: The chip vendors are now financing the compute they sell. On Tuesday Nvidia said it will invest $3 billion in Meta's equity offering and AMD $1 billion, and Meta priced the deal upsized: $25 billion of common stock at $625 a share plus $12.5 billion of 6.50% mandatory convertible preferred, $37.5 billion in all. Meta will add Vera Rubin, Vera CPUs and Spectrum-X networking, and has AMD Helios racks installed and in testing with a custom MI450 to come. The same morning Naver signed a contract for up to $9 billion of GPUs and data centres through a Brookfield-funded vehicle, which meets the condition for Nvidia's $1 billion equity investment in Naver. Buyers with balance sheets or revenue outside AI get equity and structured leases. Standalone neoclouds pay for credit: CoreWeave's default insurance costs more than twice what it did in June. On the public tape, all 70 list prints confirmed with no changes.
